title: azzardare
definition: To dare, venture, or risk saying or doing something despite uncertainty.

examples.it: Non ti azzardare a mettere l'ananas sulla pizza! 🍕
examples.en: Don't you dare put pineapple on pizza! 🍍🚫

note: Besides its transitive use (azzardare un'ipotesi), it is very common in the reflexive form 'azzardarsi', especially in expressions like 'Non ti azzardare a...!', meaning 'Don't you dare...!'.
